args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE finished landscape loading-screen image for the Forbidden City running game, 4:3 aspect ratio, ideally 2048 x 1536 PNG. Generate a completely new scene, not a reference sheet, collage or edit of an existing scene.
Input image roles: Image 1 is the authoritative Puyi face, hat, costume and cape identity reference. Image 2 is the authoritative cape back and SINGLE center-back braid reference. Image 3 supports the running pose and cape motion. Image 4 shows the actual game's environment colors, daylight and materials only; do not copy its props, camera distance, UI or layout. All are references, none is an edit target.
Primary request: the SAME young emperor Puyi from these references is running energetically forward diagonally along an EMPTY Forbidden City alley. His torso and legs clearly continue running forward while he turns his head BACK OVER HIS SHOULDER toward the nearby camera, with a charming mischievous smile and visible face, as if playfully daring someone to catch him. Convey that thought through expression only, NEVER through written words.
Character identity: preserve this boy's recognizable round youthful face, warm brown almond eyes, dark eyebrows, black hair with exactly ONE center-back braid, black imperial hat with small red crown and gold finial. Match the imperial golden-yellow robe AND a separate flowing golden-yellow cape, blue-gray dragon/cloud embroidery, wave-patterned hem, dark blue cuffs and collar, black belt with gold round ornaments, charcoal trousers and black boots with pale soles. The cape is gold, not red; it has one continuous softly curving hem. Match the existing stylized 3D game character proportions and face; no redesign or adult face.
Camera and pose: close tracking drone VIEWPOINT, slightly ABOVE and to the rear/side, looking obliquely downward, close enough that the turned face and mischievous smile are clearly readable. Three-quarter running body and trailing cape, face turned back toward the lens. The drone is ONLY the camera viewpoint: NO drone or aircraft visible. Puyi remains crisply focused; strong coherent directional/radial motion blur on the far left/right frame edges and passing walls/paving gives speed, tapering toward a sharp center.
Backdrop and light: the game's red plaster palace walls, yellow glazed roof edges and gray stone-paved alley, softly sunlit daytime, clean attractive cinematic 3D game illustration consistent with the reference character. The route is empty. Only one character; no guards, eunuchs, crowd, collectibles, vases, benches or other obstacles.
Composition: true horizontal 4:3 image, emperor centered with full hat, face, hands, cape and feet visible, including in a centered 16:9 crop. Keep all essential character details between 15% and 82% image height, and center the face near the upper-middle area. Leave the lower roughly 20% as calm, uncluttered stone paving for a later game title; do NOT add the title. Maintain sufficient framing room, with the cape naturally streaming behind without hiding the face.
Constraints: ONE coherent finished image, no borders, lettering, captions, logos, watermark, signage, text, loading bar, buttons, interface or screenshot overlays. No literal quotation or slogan. No photographic human replacement, no extra limbs, no duplicated braids, no split cape, no change of outfit.
